correctness.rationale: The simple incidence graph has r=n/k vertices on each of its two named sides and degree k. Conversely its edges give the elements and side incidences give E and F. Thus r≥k necessarily, and k distinct cyclic shifts of a matching realize every r≥k. With either free variable fixed, the four permissible complete atomic types have multiplicities 1,k−1,k−1,n−2k+1 independently of that variable. Boolean combinations are type-dependent; a counting quantifier binding either variable sums the relevant constant multiplicities. This induction handles variable reuse, one-free-variable formulas and sentences. Cardinalities differ by a counting sentence, so there are no earlier cross-size collisions. At r=k,k+1 the complements are respectively empty and a perfect matching; at r=k+2 they are disjoint unions of even cycles with half-length at least two. Side-preserving isomorphism is classified by the multiset of these half-lengths, yielding p(r)−p(r−1). Two distinct partitions (r) and (r−2,2) exist for all r≥5. Every component of the original incidence graph uses at least k vertices per side; 2k>r at this boundary. Two supplied 15-element witnesses were checked directly against all 14,400 pairs of side bijections and for the four type multiplicities, and the example census 2,4,4,7 was independently reproduced by partition dynamic programming; replay: python /workspace/branches/independent_checks.py. The universal argument does not depend on the finite tests.

originality.rationale: Demonstrable coverage by exact equivalent enumeration and standard counting-logic invariance, not a failure to locate a paper. The purported new first-fibre census is exactly OEIS A002865's explicitly identified row/column-orbit census of square binary matrices with two ones per line, after entrywise complement and r=k+2. The logical reinterpretation identifies no smaller subset of orbits: every structure already has the same fixed-order C² type by its one-cell colored equitable partition. Uniqueness at the first two orders and nonuniqueness at the next are the immediate zero-, one-, and two-ones cases. This does not assert that an older source prints the identical composite sentence; the entire claimed boundary follows mechanically from covered ingredients.
residual_risks: The exact composite logical phrasing may or may not have appeared previously; no priority claim about that phrasing is needed for the mechanical-implication verdict.

value.rationale: The identification question is coherent, and the proof could serve as a useful illustration. But the proposed exact invariant is the already catalogued all-order orbit count under a commuting complement, with no extra logical filtering at all and only a one-line degree check for connectedness. The shift to k(k+2) and the small witnesses provide no distinct unknown invariant, boundary mechanism, or nonroutine extension meeting the scientific value requirement.
